{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check a few rows to confirm conversion
print(sales_df[['revenue', 'converted']].head())

# Confirm that 'converted' is binary and status is not affecting it
print('\nAre refunded orders correctly marked as converted?')
print(sales_df.loc[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded', 'converted'].value_counts())"}
